name: send_telegram
description: Send a plain text message to a Telegram chat.

bot_token.description: Optional. Overrides the TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN env var.

chat_id.description: Optional. Overrides the TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID env var.

parse_mode.description: Optional. 'Markdown' or 'HTML' to format the text. Omit for plain text (safest).
